raw_response: BNY Mellon described its ETF servicing business as experiencing "above-market growth" throughout 2023, characterized by strong net inflows. In 2024, the company reported continued strength with Assets Under Custody/Assets (AUCA) growing significantly year-over-year: up more than 50% in Q2 (reaching over $2 trillion), up more than 70% in Q3 (reaching $2.7 trillion), and up over 60% in Q4 (reaching $2.8 trillion). The company noted that inflows into ETFs on its platform consistently outpaced the market, driven by higher market values, net new business, and successful client mandates.
